name: Swedish Fish Original Red Chewy Candy
whyItWorks: Swedish Fish are made from sugar, invert sugar, corn syrup, and modified corn starch. They are 100% fat-free, gelatin-free, nut-free, and contain 0g fiber. Soft chew breaks down cleanly.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Chew well. A great movie theater alternative to chocolate and popcorn.
